capabilities: Render base notes as a task list in the sidebar
Change task status via checkboxes and drag-and-drop between sections
Rename notes inline and update links
Show relative or absolute due dates and highlight overdue tasks
Send reminder notifications for due and reminder dates
disambiguation: Not a standalone task manager; tasks are notes in a Bases base, with status stored in frontmatter properties.
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.10.0 or later; reminders on mobile only appear as in-app notices while Obsidian is open.
intentEvidence: A Task list view for Bases, designed to sit in the sidebar
problem: Bases has no task-oriented sidebar view, so tasks tracked as note properties are not always visible or quick to update while working in other notes.
summary: Task list view for Bases that shows each note as a task in the sidebar, with status checkboxes, drag-and-drop grouping, and due-date reminders.
